about: The source model of a Fujifilm RAF file (spec/zarrify/raf.md §5.3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/raf.md#53-elements>): the elements a parser emits, and the roles the file, its regions, its metadata records, its CFA region's TIFF, its strip and a compressed strip's stripes play, each with the constraints a file must meet to have the RAF convention's layout (spec/zarrify/raf.md §8 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/raf.md#8-raf-profile>). The parser checks them in this order; projections read a valid IR and check nothing.

elements.about: The IR of a RAF file. J, M and C are the embedded JPEG's, the metadata records' and the CFA region's offsets, from the directory; s the strip's offset in the CFA region (tag 0xF007).

header.type: the 132-byte header as one record: magic cstr[16], format_version cstr[4], camera_id cstr[8], camera cstr[32], directory_version cstr[4], reserved bytes[20], directory >u4[12]

jpeg.extent: (J, n), when its length n is not 0: the embedded JPEG, opaque, never read

cfa_tiff.extent: (C, s): the CFA region up to its strip, its TIFF

samples.extent: (C + s, 2 w h), of an uncompressed strip

stripe_tables.extent: (C + s + 16, t): the blocks' sizes and, of a lossy strip, the q_base runs

stripes.form: {geometry: {data_type: uint16, shape: [h, w]}, codec: {refkv.fuji_compressed: configuration, sizes}, recipe: [[src, 0, null]]}
stripes.extent: (C + s + 16 + t, the blocks' sizes' sum), of a compressed strip

constraints.message: file too short for a 132-byte RAF header
the {name} of {length} bytes at {offset} is outside the {size}-byte file past its header
the {a} at {a_offset} and the {b} at {b_offset} overlap

given.offset: the directory's word 11, a second frame's CFA region

constraints.message: a second frame, its CFA region at {offset} (an EXR or SuperCCD camera's), which the profile does not read
metadata records of {length} bytes, not from 4 to 1048576

given.inside: whether every record lies within the records' bytes

constraints.message: {count} metadata records, more than 255
the {count} metadata records run past their {length} bytes

given.tiff: whether it starts with a TIFF header and IFD 0
given.raw_ifd: whether IFD 0 has a raw IFD (tag 0xF000) within the region's first 65536 bytes

constraints.message: the CFA region at {offset} is not a TIFF (an older FinePix camera's bare samples), which the profile does not read
the CFA region's TIFF has no raw IFD (tag 0xF000) within its first 65536 bytes

given.name: the tag's meaning
given.present: whether the raw IFD has it, one SHORT or LONG

constraints.message: the raw IFD has no {name} (tag {tag}, one SHORT or LONG)

given.offset: the strip's offset in the CFA region (0xF007)
given.head: the bytes of the region the profile reads first

constraints.message: the strip at {offset} of the {region}-byte CFA region is not within its first 65536 bytes, after its TIFF header, with 16 bytes

given.compressed: whether the strip starts with a compressed strip's header (IS)

constraints.message: a {bytes}-byte strip of {width} × {height} samples, {per} bytes a sample: packed samples, which the profile does not read

given.end: the strip's offset plus 2 w h, exactly

constraints.message: the uncompressed samples end at {end_shown}, past the CFA region's end at {region_end}
a compressed strip's lossless flag {lossless}, neither 0 nor 1
a compressed strip of raw type {raw_type}, neither 0 (Bayer) nor 16 (X-Trans)
a compressed strip of {bits}-bit samples, not 12, 14 or 16
a compressed strip of {block}-column blocks, not 768

constraints.require: height >= 6 && height <= max_height && int(height / 6) && groups == height / 6
constraints.message: a compressed strip of {height} rows in {groups} row groups: not a multiple of 6 from 6 to 16386, 6 rows a group

constraints.require: blocks >= 1 && rounded_width == blocks * block && width >= 1 && width <= rounded_width && rounded_width - width < block
constraints.message: a compressed strip {width} wide in {blocks} blocks of {block}, rounded to {rounded_width}
a compressed strip of {width} × {height} samples in a raw IFD of {tiff_width} × {tiff_height}

given.valid: whether metadata record 0x0131 is present, of 36 bytes, each 0, 1 or 2

constraints.message: an X-Trans strip without its pattern (metadata record 0x0131 of 36 bytes, each 0, 1 or 2)

given.fits: whether the strip's tables lie within the CFA region
given.end: the end of the last stripe, exactly

constraints.message: a compressed strip's {tables} bytes of tables run past the CFA region's end at {region_end}
the compressed stripes end at {end_shown}, past the CFA region's end at {region_end}
